title: The Foundation Where Debt Becomes Stone

features.name: the-ledger-rows
features.desc-on-touch: Rows and rows of stone. Each stone is a page, each page a debt. They stretch deeper than sight.

features.name: the-stone-that-remembers-every-debt
features.desc-on-touch: This stone hums with the weight of every unpaid thing. It remembers them all. It has become the ledger.

features.name: the-line-where-numbers-became-architecture
features.desc-on-touch: A line marks the boundary. On one side: arithmetic. On the other: the structure that debt became.

features.name: the-weight-of-forgetting
features.desc-on-touch: Forgetting the debt does not erase it. It only makes the stone heavier. What is forgotten becomes what is carried.

inscription: here the debts learned that their only hope was to become indispensable

file.name: Ancient_Ledger_Page_Where_Debt_Became_Structure.txt
file.note: An account so old that the entries have turned to stone. The debts are now the foundation. They cannot be moved.

reverie.title: REVERIE — where you knelt and understood the weight
narr: You kneel together in the red earth, hands pressed down.
The ground is heavy - not from stone, but from all
the things never returned, never settled. She kneels
beside you and places her hand where yours is. You both
feel it: the weight you're carrying is the weight that
holds everything up. Forgetting won't lighten it. Only

where debt learned to grow deeper into the earth
down to the oldest ledger where the first debt was made stone
